name: your-call
description: Choice UI tool (select, multi, rank, compare matrix, wizard, regenerate), approve-plan tool, in-thread charts, plus skills ask-dont-guess, show-dont-tell, phone-a-friend and ask-the-audience

autoConfirm.title: Confirm on pick
autoConfirm.description: In a single-step pane, picking an option confirms it (no Next press, no tweak note)

rememberPicks.title: Remember my picks
rememberPicks.description: Mark the option you chose last time for the same question

idleMinutes.title: Remind after (minutes)
idleMinutes.description: Toast if a decision is still waiting on you; 0 turns it off

giveUpMinutes.title: Give up after (minutes)
giveUpMinutes.description: Tell Claude there was no answer after this long; 0 waits forever

confidence.title: Ask how sure you are
confidence.description: Show a low/medium/high row; the answer is returned with your pick

timeoutPick.title: Use the recommended option on timeout
timeoutPick.description: If you never answer, pick the recommended option instead of reporting no answer (only when every step has one)
